name: Stargardt病

summary.text: A rare ophthalmic disorder that is usually characterized by a progressive loss of central vision associated with irregular macular and perimacular yellow-white fundus flecks, and a so-called ''beaten bronze'' atrophic central macular lesion.
summary.evidence: A rare ophthalmic disorder that is usual
